t: In front of you is Load, a sculpture by Alan Thornhill. Thornhill was a British artist who lived from 1921 to 2020, and his work grew out of a long association with clay, starting in pottery and developing into sculpture. He made small and large sculptures, portrait heads, paintings and drawings, and he worked in ways that let him dispense with an internal armature and improvise. Look at the surface of this piece and the way it has been shaped, and think about the title.
